newsitem.title: USA: PSC oks pricing for NYNEX network elements.
newsitem.headline: PSC oks pricing for NYNEX network elements.

text.p: The New York State Public Service Commission said Wednesday that it has approved a two-zone pricing plan for elements of NYNEX's local telephone network that will be used by its competitors.
The plan lets NYNEX's competitors pay NYNEX for using NYNEX network hardware, such as telephone lines and switches, to build new telephone networks or expand existing networks of their own.
The Commission said the prices are based on a two-zone plan that recognizes cost differences between major cities and the rest of the state.
The most popular hardware is expected to be NYNEX links, the wires connecting customers and their local phone companies.

The Commission said that under the two-zone pricing plan, NYNEX competitors would pay $12.49 to lease space on links in major cities, down from the $19.32 current statewide average. In other parts of the state, they would pay $19.24 for link space, the Commission said.
